items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: he used to play at Big Du Bois, Calvary. Well, he was playing piano and I was playing piano.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. a blind teacher called Rosebud, and he used to play at Big Du Bois, Calvary. Well, he was playing piano and I was playing piano.
Was he a guy around Clarence Williams age?
